We compared both editions of GTA 6 to see what the extra money buys, chapter by chapter, using two separate save files on the same console.

The Standard Edition contains the full story; the upgrade only adds cosmetic items, a few businesses and a handful of exclusive vehicles.

Grotti Cheetah ('95)

The '95 Grotti Cheetah is an Ultimate Edition exclusive and arrives late in the story.

Dinka Enduro

The army-green Dinka Enduro is part of the Ultimate Edition safehouse vehicles.
